overview: The tab-complete packet is a favorite target for exploit and spam checks because its text field is fully client-controlled. Grim runs two checks (blank completion and length cap), BetterAnticheat flags empty completions, and Intave rewrites completions to hide its own commands. Most of the remaining corpus hits are Bukkit TabCompleter plumbing for anticheat commands, not packet checks.

checks.name: ChatA blank tab complete (Grim)
checks.purpose: Flag and cancel tab-complete packets that carry no meaningful text.
checks.how_it_works: On TAB_COMPLETE (1.13+ only), wraps the packet and checks whether the text is "/" or empty after trimming. If so, the check flags and cancels the packet before it reaches the server.
checks.detects: Clients spamming empty tab-complete requests, which is a server-lag and exploit primitive.
checks.variations: BetterAnticheat ImpossibleCompletionCheck implements the same empty-text idea (see below).

checks.name: CrashH tab complete length (Grim)
checks.purpose: Block oversized tab-complete requests that crash the server command tree.
checks.how_it_works: Caps the tab-complete text at 256 characters for normal players and 32500 for players who can use gamemaster blocks, and mirrors Paper's patch: any request over 64 characters must contain a space before index 64. Violations are cancelled and flagged with the offending length.
checks.detects: Tab-complete crash payloads, absurd length values, and command-tree abuse via the completion field.
checks.variations: No other anticheat in the corpus enforces a tab-complete length cap.

checks.name: ImpossibleCompletionCheck (BetterAnticheat)
checks.purpose: Catch tab completions sent with no typed text at all.
checks.how_it_works: On TAB_COMPLETE, wraps the packet and fails when the text field is empty, since vanilla requires some input before a completion can be requested.
checks.detects: Clients sending empty completion requests, usually as part of a packet-spam or exploit sequence.
checks.variations: Grim ChatA runs the same logic with packet cancellation; the BetterAnticheat version only records a fail.

checks.name: CommandFilter tab complete (Intave)
checks.purpose: Hide Intave's own commands from tab completion and harden the completion stream against tab-kick crashes.
checks.how_it_works: On inbound CHAT and TAB_COMPLETE packets, rewrites "/iac" and "/intave" prefixes to a forwarder command for players without permission. On outbound TAB_COMPLETE, strips any suggestion containing "/intave" or "/iac" before it reaches the client.
checks.detects: Nothing malicious by itself. It is a hardening filter over the tab-complete stream that also prevents players from discovering the anticheat through completions.
checks.variations: SafeguardAC registers a TabComplete check in its check list, but its source is not present in the corpus, only the compiled class.
